corrections.detail: Additional actual pp957 personally viewed after lexical checkpoint: selected final ዐመፅ is injustice family957–958, not identical to the different ግፍዕ oppression family1213. Original checkpoint observation remains unchanged.
Actual native134 shows printed ellipsis; retain it, no completion. Held source uses modern unknown for mouth-form and a tentative ሎቱ to-it reading, not a new accepted correction.
Head መባልዕት at491 redirects to preceding መብልዕ crossing490–491. Actual photo controls do not resolve selected native object noun; do not import instruments or food by lexical association.
